metadata.description: GraphOps blockchain data services for Claude: RPC, Subgraphs, Substreams and the GraphOps CLI.

plugins.name: graphops
plugins.description: Choose between GraphOps RPC, Subgraphs and Substreams, handle GraphOps API keys and error codes, and search the GraphOps documentation through its MCP server.

plugins.name: graphops-rpc
plugins.description: Read EVM and Bitcoin chain data with GraphOps RPC: query blocks, balances, contract calls and event logs through the RPC MCP server, and write bounded, recoverable JSON-RPC code.

plugins.name: graphops-subgraphs
plugins.description: Query indexed blockchain entities with GraphOps Subgraphs: read schemas, freshness and query results through the Subgraphs MCP server, and write paginated GraphQL code.

plugins.name: graphops-substreams
plugins.description: Stream ordered blockchain data with GraphOps Substreams: run packages, backfill block ranges and build sinks that resume from cursors and handle reorgs.

plugins.name: graphops-platform
plugins.description: Deploy and promote Managed Subgraphs, manage Endpoint Aliases, API keys and service accounts, read usage and credits, and run code with stored API keys, through the GraphOps CLI signed in as you.
